summary: MSP Recovery, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a $0.3 million advance from VRM MSP Recovery Partners, LLC to support operating expenses. The filing is a routine disclosure of a material definitive agreement involving additional funding and amendments to existing transaction documents. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. The agreement clarifies payment procedures and collection account controls but does not involve a change of control, strategic review, or capital return event. The filing is an ordinary current report updating existing contractual terms.
